extDescription.message: Search for the selected text in search engines

hotkey_info.message: The names shown for the pressed keys aren't always correct, but the hotkey should still work correctly.

engines_intro.message: Manage the search engines used for the selected text. Drag the handle on the left to reorder them.

engines_help_url.message: The search url must start with http:// or https://. %s in the url is replaced with the selected text. Urls without %s can be used as shortcuts when “Allow engines without selection” is enabled in the “General” tab.

engines_help_post.message: Searches using the POST method must contain a {POSTARGS} separator followed by the post arguments, like this: http://example.com/search/{POSTARGS}q=%s&type=123

vars_page_host.message: The hostname and port of the current page. (chrome.google.com)

vars_page_url.message: The entire URL of the current page. (https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/gipnlpdeieaidmmeaichnddnmjmcakoe)

vars_page_origin.message: The protocol and hostname of the current page. (https://chrome.google.com)

vars_page_origin_no_encoding.message: Same as %PAGE_ORIGIN, but without URL encoding for raw usage in the url. (https://chrome.google.com)

vars_page_query_string.message: The query string of the current page. (key1=value1&key2=value2)

vars_page_qs_var.message: A query string variable from the current page. (%PAGE_QS_VAR(key1) == value1)

vars_page_qs_var_no_encoding.message: Same as %PAGE_QS_VAR, but does not encode special characters.

vars_current_domain.message: If the icon url is set to “CURRENT_DOMAIN” the favicon from the current domain is used.

vars_copy.message: If the search url is set to “COPY” the selection is copied to the clipboard.

vars_plus.message: Replaces spaces in the selection with +.

vars_raw.message: Inserts the selection into the url without doing any encoding/escaping.

vars_cp1251.message:
Encodes the selection with the CP1251/cyrillic encoding. This is used by some russian sites.

For searches using the POST method you should not use this placeholder. Instead append {POSTENCODING}CP1251 to the search url. Example: http://example.com/search/{POSTARGS}q=%s&type=123{POSTENCODING}CP1251

vars_special_encoding.message:
Some web sites require the selected text to be encoded in an encoding other than the default UTF-8 encoding. This is often the case for Asian and Russian sites.

If your search does not work correctly and the searched text ends up with scrambled characters, you can try to append {SPECIALENCODING} to the end of the search url: http://example.com/search?q=%s{SPECIALENCODING}

This may be enough to make the search work. If it still does not work, you can specify the exact encoding: http://example.com/search?q=%s{SPECIALENCODING}EUC-KR

vars_converters_intro.message: Converters can be used to transform the selection before it is inserted into the url. They work with the {%s}, {%+s} and {%(CP1251)s} placeholders.

vars_upper.message: Converts the selection to all upper case letters. (My Selection → MY SELECTION)

vars_lower.message: Converts the selection to all lower case letters. (My Selection → my selection)

vars_replace_intro.message: This converter uses regular expressions to allow user defined replacements on the selection, using the standard javascript regular expression syntax. Usage:

vars_replace_usage.message:
match: Regular expression to match something in the string.

replacement: What to replace the match with. Can contain $1, $2, …, $n, values that are replaced with the corresponding regular expression match group.

flags: Optional, a list of regular expression flags.

/ is normally used as a separator in the expressions. The first character after replace: is used as the separator, so if you need / for something else in the expression you can use any other character as a separator (| and } can be problematic). So {%s|replace:#/#!#g} is valid and will replace all “/” with “!”.

The character | has a special meaning in regular expressions. If you want to use this character in your expression you have to use a double || as your converter separator.

If you need to use } in the expression, you have to use \}, as this character is used to enclose the selection placeholder. (This is currently not working properly)

vars_replace_ex1.message: Replaces all whitespace in the selection with “-”.

vars_replace_ex2.message: Removes any whitespace in the selection.

vars_replace_ex3.message: Replaces the first a in the selection with a b.

vars_replace_ex4.message: Adds $ to the front of any number in the selection. A triple $ must be used because the first two are needed to produce a literal $ in the replacement, and the last $1 is replaced with the matched number.

vars_replace_ex5.message: Replaces apple or orange with fruit, ignoring case differences. Notice the use of “||” as the converter separator, because “|” is used in the replacement expression.

edit_url_title.message: Edit the url in a larger editor

url_editor_newline_help.message: Newlines are stored as %0A in the url, so you can write multi-line text such as AI prompts. Press Ctrl+Enter to apply.

url_editor_preview.message: Preview: when this text is selected

url_editor_preview_note.message: Current page variables (%PAGE_URL etc.) are not replaced in the preview. Click the resulting link to try it in a new tab.

engine_opt_show_in_note.message: This only has effect when “Separate search engines for popup and context menu” is enabled in the “General” tab.

engine_opt_hide_on_click_desc.message: The menu will be hidden after clicking this search engine.

engine_opt_hide_on_click_submenu_desc.message: The menu will be hidden after clicking this submenu.

engine_opt_openall_desc.message: When this is checked all search engines in this submenu will be opened at once.

engine_opt_hidemenu_desc.message: The submenu will not open on mouse over. It will just open all searches inside on click. (Has no effect in the toolbar popup)

engine_opt_openall_aux_desc.message: All engines will only open when the submenu is clicked with the middle mouse button. (No effect in the right click context menu)

engine_opt_incognito_desc.message: The search will open in a new incognito window.

engine_opt_new_window_desc.message: The search will open in a new browser window.

engine_opt_popup_window_desc.message: The new window will be a small popup window. (Only has effect if “New window” or “Incognito mode” is enabled)

engine_opt_negate_newtab_desc.message: Negates the global “Open search in new tab” option for this search engine.

engine_opt_submenu_url_note.message: For submenus these options only apply if you have defined a custom search url for the submenu.

engine_opt_hotkey_desc.message: Use this hotkey to search the selected text with this search engine.

find_engines_ctrl_alt.message: You can add new engines by finding a search form, holding down CTRL+ALT and clicking inside the input where you would type your search query. A popup opens where you can edit and save the search engine. This works for a lot of searches, but sometimes it doesn't work.

find_engines_mycroft.message: With the form below you can search for new search engines at mycroftproject.com. Look for the icon in the search results and click it to add an engine. The search page must be completely loaded before the icon shows. Previously opened tabs must be reloaded to show the new engines.

general_intro.message: How searches are opened, and options shared by the menus.

opt_background_tab_desc.message: Only useful if “Open search in new tab” is enabled, or when opening multiple tabs at once, e.g. opening all searches in a submenu.

opt_open_new_tab_last.message: Open new tabs in last position

opt_open_new_tab_last_desc.message: Only affects searches from the context menu. The popup uses the browser's default behavior and is not affected by this option. By default the new tab opens next to the current tab.

pwa_tip.message:
To open search results in an installed PWA app (e.g. YouTube)

  • Enable “Open search in new tab” and disable “Open search in background tab”.
  • “New window”, “Incognito mode” and “Negate new tab option” in the engine options must be off.
  • This only works for searches from the popup menu on web pages. The context menu and toolbar popup always open a browser tab.
  • “Open supported links” must be enabled in the app settings in Chrome (right click the app in chrome://apps).

opt_allow_without_selection_desc.message: Allows the popup and context menu to be opened without selecting text first. This is useful for using the extension as a link collection for quick navigation to frequently used urls. When enabled, all search engines are shown even when no text is selected. Engines with %s search for an empty string; engines without %s navigate directly.

opt_separate_engines.message: Separate search engines for popup and context menu

opt_separate_engines_desc.message: Choose for each search engine whether it is shown in the popup, the context menu and the toolbar popup.

opt_separate_engines_edit.message: Click the wrench next to the search engines to edit.

opt_sort_by_click_desc.message: The engines are sorted by usage count, so that the most used search engines are placed first in the menu.

opt_allow_newline_desc.message: Allow the popup and toolbar popup to open when the selection contains newline characters. May sometimes cause the popup to open when it is not supposed to.

opt_disable_extractform.message: Disable CTRL+ALT+click shortcut for adding search engines

opt_disable_extractform_desc.message: It can sometimes be buggy, so if you don't use it you can disable it.

opt_ai_chat_autosend_desc.message: Puts the q, prompt or custom_query value of a gemini.google.com or claude.ai/new url into the prompt box and sends it. The currently selected model is used; the model menu and the sidebar are not touched.

opt_ai_chat_gemini_temp_chat.message: Gemini: send in a temporary chat

opt_ai_chat_gemini_temp_chat_desc.message: Switches to a temporary chat before sending. The query is not sent if the temporary chat can't be confirmed. Images sent with “Search by capturing an area” follow this setting too.

opt_ai_chat_claude_incognito_desc.message: Reopens the page with incognito added to the url if it is missing, then sends. The query is not sent if incognito mode can't be confirmed. Images sent with “Search by capturing an area” follow this setting too.

ai_chat_tip.message:
Example search engine urls

  • Gemini: https://gemini.google.com/app?q=%s
  • Claude: https://claude.ai/new?incognito=true&q=%s — with incognito=true in the url the chat opens in incognito mode right away and does not need to be reopened.
  • Multi-line prompts can be written with the "Edit the url in a larger editor" button in the search engine list.

capture_heading.message: Search by capturing an area (Google Lens · Gemini · Claude)

opt_capture_context_menu_desc.message: Adds “Search by capturing an area” to the menu you get when right clicking a page, image or link (not when text is selected). It is shown even if the search engine context menu is disabled.

opt_capture_toolbar_button_desc.message: Adds a capture button below the search engines of the toolbar popup.

opt_capture_question_desc.message: Filled into the question box for Gemini and Claude. When the question is empty the image is only attached and you type the question yourself.

capture_tip.message:
How it works

  • Drag an area of the page, then choose Google Lens, Gemini or Claude. Press Esc to cancel.
  • Gemini and Claude get the image together with the question. It is sent automatically only if there is a question and “Type and send queries automatically” is on, otherwise the image is only attached. The temporary chat and incognito settings above apply as well.
  • The screenshot is sent to the service you choose.
  • It does not work on browser pages such as chrome:// or the Chrome Web Store.

popup_intro.message: The popup menu shown when you select text on a web page.

activator_label.message: How to open the popup menu

activator_disabled_desc.message: The popup menu is not shown on web pages. Search engine hotkeys and the context menu still work.

activator_combo_desc.message: Select the activators to use. The options for each selected activator are shown below.

activator_click_desc.message: The menu is activated by clicking on the selection with this mouse button.

auto_show_directly.message: Show the menu directly when selecting text

auto_show_directly_desc.message: By default, a small button appears when some text is selected, and you open the menu by moving the mouse over the button. This option skips the button and shows the menu directly.

auto_relative_to_mouse.message: Position the button relative to the mouse cursor

auto_relative_to_mouse_desc.message: The button appears to the top right of the cursor. The position can be tweaked with custom css under “Styling”.

auto_in_inputs_desc.message: Enables the auto activator in inputs and textareas. Without this option you have to CTRL + left click the selection in the input for the menu to show. “Show in inputs and textareas” under “Behavior” must also be enabled.

k_and_m_desc.message: Click the input and press the keys to use. The menu is activated by holding the keys and clicking anywhere with the selected mouse button.

styling_theme_desc.message: Choose a preset or customize the menu with CSS.

styling_circular_desc.message: Toggling this overwrites any custom styling, and the options page is saved and reloaded.

styling_css_help.message:
Here you can customize the look of the menu with Cascading Style Sheets.

You can also use special properties (unique to Selection Search) that change the way your menu or auto button behaves. These special properties are added to your CSS as comments between the keywords CONFIG_START and CONFIG_END. (See the CSS of the “Icons only” styling preset for an example configuration.)

submenu_corner, submenu_position: Define where the submenu is placed when it is opened from the main popup menu. submenu_position defines the corner of the submenu button (of the main menu) that the submenu is placed at, and submenu_corner defines the exact corner of the submenu to place at submenu_position. Valid values are topright, topleft, bottomright and bottomleft.

menu_edge_right, menu_edge_bottom, menu_edge_left, menu_edge_top: Define how the menu should be repositioned if it falls outside of the browser window. If one of these properties has the value auto, the menu is automatically repositioned to fit inside the window and to be flush with the window edge that it crossed. If one of these properties has a pixel value such as 10px, the menu is moved that amount in the corresponding direction, without any automatic repositioning done beforehand. This makes it possible to prevent the menu from covering the selection whenever the selection is next to one of the window's edges.

button_edge_right, button_edge_bottom, button_edge_left, button_edge_top: Define how the auto button (when using the Auto activator) is repositioned if it falls outside of the browser window. The possible values are the same as for the menu_edge_* properties, and their effect is similar.

opt_show_tooltips_desc.message: Show a tooltip with the search engine name when hovering the mouse over the search engines in the popup.

opt_disable_effects_desc.message: Disables javascript effects, e.g. the fading in/out effect when the popup appears. This has no effect on CSS effects added using custom styling.

opt_show_in_inputs_desc.message: Enable this if you want to be able to select some text in an input or textarea and do a search. To show the popup, select some text and then hold CTRL and click inside the input or textarea. With the auto activator you click with the left button, with the mouse activator you use the button chosen above.

opt_hide_on_click_desc.message: The popup closes after you click a search engine.

opt_open_on_dblclick_desc.message: The popup opens when you double click to select a word.

opt_selection_length_limit_desc.message: If the selection is longer than this limit the popup will not open.

opt_auto_hide_delay_desc.message: The popup is automatically hidden if you do not move the mouse over it within this time. This also affects the button shown by the auto activator. 0 = no auto hide. (milliseconds, 1000 = 1 second)

opt_hide_on_scroll_desc.message: Also hides the auto activator popup button.

blacklist_desc.message: The blacklist can be used to disable the popup on specific sites. Enter one rule per line.

blacklist_syntax_intro.message: To block specific sites you define rules using the following syntax:

opt_use_whitelist_desc.message: When enabled the list is used as a whitelist, i.e. the popup only loads on matched sites. The list must be non-empty for this option to take effect.

opt_use_blacklist_for_hotkeys_desc.message: When enabled the blacklist/whitelist also affects the search engine hotkeys.

contextmenu_intro.message: Shows the search engines in the context menu when you right click on the selected text.

contextmenu_desc.message: This option has some limits: the icons are not shown and you can only click on one menu item before the menu closes.

toolbar_intro.message: The search box shown when clicking the Selection Search icon in the upper right corner of the browser. You may have to open the extensions menu to find the icon if you have many extensions installed.

toolbar_enable_desc.message: When disabled the toolbar icon is disabled and does not open the popup.

toolbar_shortcut_desc.message: You can assign a shortcut to the toolbar popup using the browser's builtin shortcut feature. Find Selection Search in the list.

toolbar_icons_only_desc.message: Hide search engine names in the toolbar popup.

toolbar_hotkeys_desc.message: Whether the hotkeys work while the input box has focus depends on the “Show in inputs and textareas” setting in the “Popup menu” tab.

toolbar_suggestions_desc.message: Show search suggestions when typing in the search input.

toolbar_css_help.message: Here you can customize the look of the toolbar popup using Cascading Style Sheets. Right click on the toolbar icon and select “Inspect popup” to see and experiment with the html of the popup. After saving, the css is applied the next time you open the toolbar popup.

sync_intro.message: Synchronize your search engines and settings between browsers on different computers.

sync_engines_desc.message: Individual search engines can be excluded from sync in the engine options (wrench icon).

sync_warning.message: If you have multiple browsers with different settings and search engines you have to be careful when enabling the sync options, because the last browser that enables sync will overwrite the previous ones.

backup_intro.message: Export your settings to store them somewhere, or import previously exported settings.

export_desc.message: Copy the data below and store it somewhere, it can later be imported to restore your settings. Only saved settings are exported, so save your changes first.

import_desc.message: Paste the data you have previously exported, select the options you want to import and click “Import”.

import_replace_engines.message: Replace existing search engines (otherwise they are added to the end)

reset_desc.message: Deletes all your search engines and resets all the changes you have made. This cannot be undone, so export a backup first.

confirm_circular_menu.message:
This will overwrite any custom styling. If you want to keep your styling you have to cancel and take a backup of the style before you proceed.

The options page will be saved and reloaded if you click OK.

confirm_restore.message: This will delete all your search engines and reset all the changes you have made.

confirm_import.message:
This will overwrite your existing settings.

Are you sure you want to continue?

confirm_import_replace_engines.message:
This will overwrite your existing settings and your search engines.

Are you sure you want to continue?

import_nothing_selected.message: No data imported. Select at least one item to import.

notif_icon_store_failed_title.message: Failed to store search engine icon

notif_icon_store_failed.message: Some search engine icons may not show properly. A restart of the browser may help to free up old data from memory. If not please report the issue.

notif_sync_failed.message: Failed to synchronize your settings. Sync has been disabled. ($error$)

notif_sync_parse_failed.message: Failed to parse chunked search engines ($error$)

notif_sync_available.message: Synchronization of search engines and settings between browsers is now available. It has been disabled by default, but can be enabled in the settings.

mycroft_banner.message: Click the icon next to a search engine to add it to the Selection Search extension.

post_invalid_url.message: Invalid url for a POST search. The url must contain “{POSTARGS}”

encoding_redirecting.message: You will now be redirected to:

ai_chat_private_failed.message: Could not confirm the switch to $mode$. The query was not sent.

ai_chat_private_lost.message: Sending was stopped because $mode$ was turned off.

ai_chat_no_editor.message: Could not find the $site$ prompt box.

ai_chat_insert_failed.message: Could not type the query into the $site$ prompt box.

ai_chat_send_unconfirmed.message: Could not confirm that the query was sent.

ai_chat_no_send_button.message: Could not find an enabled send button.

ai_chat_image_attached.message: The image was attached. Type your question.

ai_chat_image_question_ready.message: The image and the question are in place. Send it when you are ready.

ai_chat_attach_failed.message: Could not attach the image to $site$.

ai_chat_task_expired.message: The captured image is no longer available. Capture it again.

capture_hint.message: Drag to select an area. Press Esc to cancel.

capture_question_placeholder.message: Question (optional, sent with the image to Gemini / Claude)

capture_error_unavailable.message: Area capture is not available on this page.

capture_error_too_small.message: The selected area is too small.

capture_lens_failed.message: Could not put the image into Google Lens.

capture_copied_hint.message: The image was copied to the clipboard, paste it with Ctrl+V.
